archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-10.1 Identify and Segment Stakeholders
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
The first step is to map out who the stakeholders are. Statistical organizations serve many different audiences — from government ministries and researchers to journalists, businesses, international bodies, and citizens.
Each group has different expectations, data literacy levels, and use cases. Therefore, the organization classifies its stakeholders into segments such as data providers, policymakers, academic users, internal staff, or the general public.
For each segment, their needs, communication preferences, and influence are identified. This mapping forms the foundation for a targeted engagement strategy.
Value created: A clear understanding of who the organization’s stakeholders are and what they need from its data and services.
